settings.title: GitHub
settings.intro: Lifecycle artifacts are mirrored into each product's repository in the {org} organization. Only private repositories can be linked.
settings.help1: Go to GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens.
settings.help2: Set the resource owner to the code92-dev organization, not your personal account.
settings.help3: Under Repository permissions, set Contents to Read and write. Metadata is selected automatically.
settings.help4: If the organization requires approval, an owner must approve the token before it works here.

repo.title: Repository
repo.none: No repository connected. Lifecycle artifacts are stored in the platform only.
repo.notConfigured: An admin has to connect GitHub in Settings before products can be linked.
repo.pickHint: Private repositories in {org}. A repository can belong to only one product.
repo.empty: No private repositories found in {org} that this token can see.
repo.unlinkConfirm: Disconnect this repository? Files already pushed stay in the repository.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.not_configured: GitHub is not connected yet. An admin can set it up in Settings.
errors.token_invalid: GitHub rejected that token. Check that it was copied in full and has not expired.
errors.org_unreachable: The token cannot reach the code92-dev organization. Check that its resource owner is the organization, and that an owner has approved it.
errors.github_error: GitHub returned an error. Please try again.
errors.repo_not_in_org: That repository does not belong to the code92-dev organization.
errors.repo_public: That repository is public. Lifecycle artifacts can include threat models and pentest reports, so only private repositories can be linked.
errors.repo_no_write: The token cannot write to that repository.
errors.repo_taken: That repository is already linked to another product.
errors.storage_error: The uploaded file could not be read back for mirroring.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
